reason: A is better grounded and more testable: it links vacancy-mediated diffusion barriers to measurable diffusion, segregation, phase, and grain-growth outcomes, with relevant supporting evidence and an explicit falsification rule. It still risks confounding element count with chemistry and overgeneralizing sluggish diffusion to grain-boundary-dominated nanoalloys, but B adds an unsupported ~0.8 melting-temperature boundary and a questionable claim of uniform entropy-induced lattice distortion without evidence.
